messages:
maya: Quick sync on compact request drilldown — thinking through where the correlation ID and export actions should live. Two options: inline with the metadata row or pinned in the top-right header. Also spotted low contrast on the error badge in dark mode.
devin: My vote is header for consistency across panes. Keeps CTAs predictable. Also prefer explicit copy wording: 'Copy correlation ID' not just 'Copy ID'.
sam: From an implementation POV header is simpler for keyboard order. If we keep the corrID inline wed need extra tabindex management per metadata row which complicates focus flow. On export: 'Download' is vague. Suggest a dropdown labelled 'Export trace ▾' with JSON / CSV choices.
oliver: Accessibility notes: copy button needs aria-label="Copy correlation ID to clipboard" and an assertive announcement on success (toast with role=alert). Small code sketch:
```html
<button class=\"btn-plain\" aria-label=\"Copy correlation ID to clipboard\" onclick=\"copyId()\">Copy</button>
```
linda: Contrast check: error badge color in dark theme is ~2.6:1 against background so fails AA. Options: higher-contrast color, outline, or add icon+text. Also ensure focus ring on the pill is visible (not just subtle shadow).
maya: For stack traces in compact view: propose collapsing long frames behind a single "Show 8 more frames" row that expands inline. For screen readers that control should expose 'button, collapsed, Show 8 more frames' and use aria-expanded.
devin: Copy suggestions: use 'Show 8 more frames' and toggled state 'Hide extra frames'. Add aria-expanded on the toggle.
sam: Performance: expanding inline works if frames are virtualized; otherwise do lazy-render on expand to avoid reflow. We'll need to check current trace renderer.
oliver: Also change export menu items from 'Export' to explicit items: 'Export trace (JSON)' and 'Export trace (CSV)'. On narrow screens show an export icon that opens an overflow menu.
maya: Keyboard order proposal for compact header: 1) Copy correlation ID, 2) Export, 3) Share permalink. That matches common flows (copy then export).
linda: For screen reader UX: after copying announce 'Correlation ID copied to clipboard'. If copy is an icon-only button, ensure it has a visible accessible name.
sam: Implementation note: permalink copy should use navigator.clipboard.writeText and show an accessible toast. Permalink generation returns tokenized URL; ensure we canonicalize before copying.
oliver: Micro-design: increase hit target of the pill to min 36px while keeping visual compactness by adjusting padding vs hit area.
maya: I'm updating Figma with a header variant and collapsed frames demo: https://www.figma.com/file/example/compact-trace-v2 (placeholder)
devin: Can we get dev estimates? sam?
sam: Rough estimates: header relocation + aria labels + copy behavior ~1d. Export dropdown + CSV option ~1d. Collapsing frames + lazy render ~2d. Contrast and focus adjustments ~0.5d. Total ~4.5d.
maya: Prioritization: 1) copy wording + aria + toast, 2) export label clarity, 3) collapsed frames with lazy render, 4) contrast fix.
devin: I'll slot this into next sprint and do a quick usability check with a couple non-design folks after Figma updates.
oliver: Tooltip text change: use 'Copy correlation ID' instead of ambiguous 'Copy' so assistive tech reads it clearly.
linda: :thumbsup: Also recommend running axe quickscan on the new screens.
maya: Thanks! I'll push updated screens and a short spec for aria attributes and keyboard order. Ping me in the thread if you spot anything else.
